if_then: If the old sentence shows up, then I do one counted action.
evening: One line at night. Not a journal.
start: Date the first line. Tomorrow is enough. Next Monday is enough.
page_line: The plan is one if-then you can count. If the old sentence shows up, then you do one action. At night, write one line.
do_not_claim: Do not quote an effect size on the page. Do not promise a result. The 2006 if-then review is larger than the 2024 correction. The method stays. The promise does not.
